tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search over docs.casama.ai (guides, self-hosting, the API, CLI, SDKs, plugins, webhooks, A2A, bot templates, contributing). Returns the best-matching sections with their address; read a whole page with read_doc.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: One docs page as markdown, by path or address: "/develop/plugins", "develop/api.md" or "https://docs.casama.ai/guide/skills". Pass section to get one ## section only.

section.description: A ## heading on the page, e.g. "Secrets"

tools.name: list_doc_pages
tools.description: Every page on docs.casama.ai with its title and address.

tools.name: get_api_operation
tools.description: Find operations in the Casama HTTP API (OpenAPI 3.1) and show their parameters, request body and responses as types. Query by operationId ("createBot"), "METHOD /path" ("POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages", concrete ids work too) or keywords ("cancel run").

tools.name: check_plugin
tools.description: Check an Agent Plugins 1.0 folder (plugin.json, mcp.json, skills/) on this computer the way Casama checks it at install: errors (refused), warnings (skipped or ignored) and tips.

path.description: The plugin folder, absolute or relative to where the server runs

tools.name: gallery_search
tools.description: Search the Casama gallery (gallery.casama.ai) for ready-made skills, apps, routines, bots, plugins, starter sets and looks before writing a new one. Returns the best matches with what each can access, what it needs and its page. Add one in Casama from its page, or start from it with `casama init --from-gallery bot/<id>` or `plugin/<id>`.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: Casama workspaces you belong to, with your role.

tools.name: list_bots
tools.description: Bots in a workspace (default: your first workspace), with their current status.

tools.name: ask_bot
tools.description: Send a message to a Casama bot and wait for its reply. The bot can use its own computer and tools; risky actions may wait for the person's approval (see what_needs_me and list_approvals). Pass conversation_id to continue a thread. Assistants that can't wait long should pass wait_seconds: if the bot is still working when it runs out, the answer says so with a run_id (follow up with get_run), and the person gets a notification when it's done.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the reply, 5–120 seconds (default: up to 10 minutes)

tools.name: react_to_message
tools.description: React to a message in a conversation with one emoji (D-331), or take your reaction back. Without message_id it reacts to the bot's latest reply. One reaction per person per message: another emoji replaces yours. The bot sees it the next time it works in that chat; a 👍 or 👎 tells it whether the reply worked.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: A run's status, cost and its recent events (tool calls, outputs, errors).

tools.name: list_approvals
tools.description: Actions waiting for a person's approval in a workspace.

tools.name: decide_approval
tools.description: Approve or deny a pending action. The bot continues (or skips the step) right away.

tools.name: what_needs_me
tools.description: What is waiting for the person in Casama: approvals (a bot wants an OK before a risky step), take-overs (a bot needs the person to do something on its computer) and suggestions. Each comes with a link that opens it in Casama. Approvals are reviewed there.

tools.name: list_routines
tools.description: The person's routines: things a bot does on a schedule or a trigger (a morning brief, a weekly report). Optionally only one bot's.

bot.description: Only this bot's routines (name or id)

tools.name: run_routine
tools.description: Start one of the person's routines now, by name or id. It runs like a scheduled run; the result arrives in Casama and as a notification. Pass request_id so a retry within a minute doesn't start it twice.

bot.description: The routine's bot, when names repeat

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Pages published on the web at their own address in a workspace, with their hosts and states.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: Connected and bought domains in a workspace: the site each shows and its state (live, waiting_dns, waiting_cert, paused, needs_attention).

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: A domain's hosts and states, the DNS records to add with what DNS shows now, renewal details and history.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check a domain's DNS and certificate now instead of waiting for the next check (admins; at most once every 10 seconds).

tools.name: connect_domain
tools.description: Connect a domain the workspace already owns (bakery.com, www.bakery.com or shop.bakery.com), optionally showing a published site. Answers the DNS records to add at the domain's DNS company (admins).

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Domain names for a few words or a name, with availability, the first year's price and the renewal price (before tax). Only a person can buy one, in the Casama app.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: Packs installed in a workspace: plugins that brought bots, skills, routines, apps and looks.

tools.name: preview_pack
tools.description: What a pack from a GitHub link (or a reviewed pack from the directory, by id) would add: bots, skills, routines, apps, looks, tools, the questions it asks, what it can reach and the commit to install.

gallery_id.description: A pack from the plugin directory

tools.name: install_pack
tools.description: Install a pack in a workspace, pinned to the commit preview_pack showed. Show the person the preview first. Secrets aren't taken here: the person adds them in the app. Packs that aren't reviewed start their routines switched off; the workspace's gallery rules apply.

explanations.title: Path traversal
explanations.why_it_matters: Traversal sequences can escape an intended directory boundary and reach unrelated files.
explanations.remediation: Canonicalize paths, verify the resolved path remains under an allowlisted root, and reject traversal forms.

explanations.title: Unrestricted URL parameter
explanations.why_it_matters: A caller-controlled URL can expose the server to untrusted content and unintended network destinations.
explanations.remediation: Prefer fixed destinations or strict allowlists and validate URL scheme, host, and resolved address.

explanations.title: Unrestricted URL parameter
explanations.why_it_matters: A caller-controlled URL can expose the server to untrusted content and unintended network destinations.
explanations.remediation: Prefer fixed destinations or strict allowlists and validate URL scheme, host, and resolved address.

explanations.title: Secrets embedded in descriptions
explanations.why_it_matters: Tool descriptions may be exposed to clients, logs, or model context and are not a safe place for credentials.
explanations.remediation: Remove credentials from descriptions, rotate exposed secrets, and retrieve secrets through a protected mechanism.
